summary: Ran the two always-on structural checks and the three declared acceptance tests for M4-S01 (Business Hours + Holidays), from .sfskills/builds/case-onboarding: xml parse (2/2 files), manifest consistency (Settings:BusinessHours member matches its one file, both directions), the declared checker check_business_hours_and_holidays.py --manifest-dir artefacts/M4-S01 (exit 0, one INFO line on the deliberately named 24/7 calendar, closed at the source by commit 5b206697a rather than by editing the artefact), and check-outputs (ok, nothing missing/empty/malformed). The one manual acceptance test was judged usable against the Given/When/Then shape and deferred to the milestone gate. All runnable tests passed; step set to tested.
confidence_rationale: Every declared test ran or was correctly classified as manual, both always-on checks completed, and every result came from an exit code this agent observed directly (Step 7 HIGH row) — no command was refused, no manifest exclusion was needed, and check-outputs reported ok.

process_observations.observation: The artefact under test is byte-for-byte identical to the file that exited 1 on the earlier blocked run; the checker-policy block was closed by scoping the checker rule at the source (commit 5b206697a) rather than by editing metadata, so this test run needed no repair pass.

package.xml and the settings file agree in both directions: the sole file-derived member (Settings:BusinessHours) is the sole named manifest member, and no wildcard is used, so the manifest check needed no coverage-gap exclusion.

The declared checker's INFO line asks the author to confirm the always-open calendar is not attached to entitlements expecting business-hour pauses, and deploy-order.md § 0 records that no step in this build currently reads the Severity 1 24x7 calendar by name — it is presently a metadata placeholder for a Severity 1 entitlement process that does not yet exist, which a checker exit code cannot see.

deploy-order.md § 4 carries an UNVERIFIED marker on whether a midnight-to-midnight start/end pair means open-all-day versus closed, and this design-only build has no org to run the prescribed clock test against, so the marker cannot be closed by any test this agent can run.

The step is now tested with 0 failures and one deferred manual test; the doc keeper is the natural next stage to carry the checker-policy history and the still-open UNVERIFIED markers into decisions.md.
process_observations.followup_reason: because the checker-policy block, its source-level fix, and the unconfirmed holiday list are decisions decisions.md should record once the step is documented.
